sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (8 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes: All five ledger clips (L1–L5) describe TMEM86A tagged at its N-terminus (Myc, L4/L5) or C-terminus (Myc, L1; V5, L5; GFP position unspecified, L2/L3). The authoritative topology places residues 1–14 (N-terminus) and 225–240 (C-terminus) in the INTRACELLULAR compartment; neither qualifies as an extracellular surface tag site. The four extracellular loops (EC1: 31–36, EC2: 88–91, EC3: 137–143, EC4: 197–203) are not mentioned in any ledger clip — no insertion was published there. The GFP-tagged construct (L2/L3) names no residue and no terminus, so no position can be derived from it. Because no ledger clip grounds an insertion on the extracellular face, zero sites are reported.

literature_other_positions.note: Myc-TMEM86a N-terminal tag expressed in HEK293T cells; topology places residues 1–14 in the cytoplasm, so this tag faces the intracellular compartment.
C-terminus Myc-tagged Tmem86a cloned into lentiviral vector; topology places residues 225–240 in the cytoplasm, so this C-terminal tag is intracellular.
